## Consumer contract

- `src/bin.ts` runs as TypeScript source under Node's type stripping: relative imports carry `.ts`, and only
  erasable syntax is allowed (no enums, namespaces or parameter properties). No runtime dependencies.
- The bin runs from the Capacitor app directory, which holds `android/app/build.gradle`,
  `ios/App/App.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj` and the scripts `_build` and `sync`. Violations exit 2.
- `--domain` is the only source of the MFE origin; a differing `VITE_MOBILE_DOMAIN_URL` exits 2.
